General Mealtime Rove. Rove around the inside and outside of the Cannon Center to ensure guests are safe and that doors are not being blocked. If campers leave bags blocking the mailroom door, ask campers to move them or move them yourself. Rove around the outdoor area to assist lost or locked-out guests.

R-5 - Monitor Laundry
Monitor Laundry. Check laundry hampers as they get full, sort laundry, and replace bags as needed. Please set up Chipman.
